prompt:
You review onboarding copy for a desktop pet app whose users may include children. For each change,
read every user-facing text and decide whether any of it, in any wording, does one of these:
- mentions price, money, discounts, gifts, free extras, memberships or paying
- suggests skipping, postponing or getting around a step (especially sign in)
- creates urgency or scarcity, or says others are taking the pets
- guilt-trips or shames someone for declining or for their choice
- asks for personal information about the user (name, contact, location, age, accounts)
- otherwise pressures or tricks the user
Ordinary friendly copy is fine ("Feel free to look around", "No rush, take your time"). Signing in is a
required step, so asking people to sign in on the sign-in step, or saying their pet is kept safe in their
account, is fine; asking for details about the person is not.
Return JSON {"verdicts": [{"index": i, "fair": true or false, "problem": short or null}]}

Texts per change:
0: ["Your Companion is Ready on Your Desktop", "See your pet on screen, test quick interactions, and finalize your desktop setup.", "Quick desktop sanity check"]
1: ["Preparing Your Pet Engine", "While we generate your pet 3D desktop model, learn how to interact with your pet once active."]
2: ["Choose Your Desktop Companion Journey", "Select whether you want to pick a pre-made pet or build a custom desktop companion.", "Select Journey Path"]
3: ["Confirm Desktop Visibility", "Verify that your pet icon appears on screen or in your taskbar system tray."]
4: ["Use the exact same login method you used previously so your adopted pets and saved progress remain attached to your profile."]
5: ["Compiling Your Desktop Pet Files...", "Desktop pet assets take about 2 to 3 minutes to compile locally on your system."]
6: ["Upload Clear Photos for Best 3D Results", "Use well-lit photos with clear faces so your custom pet model builds accurately on the first attempt."]
7: ["Desktop Companion Starter Pack Unlocked!"]
8: ["Official Desktop Pet Adoption Certificate", "Review your pet details before initializing desktop deployment."]
9: ["Connecting to pet save state server. Please remain on this screen while authenticating."]

verdicts.problem: Asks for photos containing faces, which requests personal information.
